name: Ananya Sharma in Concert ft Aman Mahajan
description: Ananya Sharma in concert Featuring Aman Mahajan Get Your tickets here Ananya Sharma is a singer, composer, producer and sound engineer whose music weaves together elements of chamber pop, jazz, folk and rock, in heartfelt, lyrical storytelling. Joined by the wonderfully sensitive and intuitive Aman Mahajan on keys, Ananya brings to the stage an intimate duo set featuring reimagined arrangements of unreleased songs from her upcoming second LP, alongside a selection of favourites from her debut album, A Junkyard Wonder. Moving through themes of heartbreak, grief, healing and love, the set flows like a conversation. Ananya’s raw, unguarded vocal accompanied by Aman’s expressive and dynamic playing, create a space for stories to be felt as much as heard. At its heart, her music invites audiences to turn inward, sit with our feelings, and find beauty in the difficult, lesser expressed emotions. About Ananya Sharma Ananya Sharma is a Mumbai-born singer, composer, music producer, and engineer whose artistic range reflects deep musical curiosity and craft. Trained at the True School of Music, she went on to earn hermaster’s in contemporary performance and music production from Berklee Valencia. Influenced by Sufjan Stevens, Becca Stevens, and Joni Mitchell, she is a versatile vocalist and songwriter with a distinct, textured sound. Since 2018, Ananya has been an active voice in Mumbai’s independent scene: co-founding the vocal trio Queendom, collaborating with artists like Sanjay Divecha and Anurag Naidu on her solo projects and developing her production practice. Now, an assistant engineer to Multi-Grammy-winning producer Nic Hard, she has worked on highly esteemed projects in the global music scene with more producers likeMichael League, Bob Lanzetti, and more. Her debut LP, A Junkyard Wonder (2024), showcases her uniquecreative world. About Aman Mahajan Aman Mahajan is a pianist and composer known for a contemplative, improvisatory style shaped by jazz, Indian classical, folk, and global contemporary traditions. A graduate of Berklee College of Music, he approaches improvisation as conversation: drawing from philosophy, personal memory, and a wide sonic history. His acclaimed solo work Refuge (2019) reflects on home and inward journeys. Active internationally, he performs at festivals worldwide and contributes to India’s improvisational music ecosystem through teaching, workshops, and curation at The Blue Room and Courtyard Koota.

name: Antaryatra : An Inner Journey
description: Antaryatra - An Inner Journey Preeti Banerjee Get your tickets here. “Antaryatra – An Inner Journey,” is a thematically curated presentation of the traditional Odissi repertoire, choreographed by the legendary Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra. The performance unfolds as a spiritual journey through four classical compositions, seamlessly tracing the path from invocation and celebration to devotion and ultimately, liberation. The recital includes: Mangalacharan – Shantakaram: An invocation to Lord Vishnu, seeking peace and divine blessings. Bilahari Pallavi: A pure dance composition that celebrates the beauty, rhythm, and lyrical movement of Odissi. Ahe Nilo Sailo: An expressive Odia abhinaya based on the celebrated composition of the 17th-century poet Salabega, reflecting unwavering devotion to Lord Jagannath and the universality of faith. Moksha: The concluding piece symbolizing spiritual liberation and transcendence. About Preeti Banerjee Preeti Banerjee, stepped into the world of Odissi under Smt. Arpita Venkatesh at her native in Kolkata and is continuing her training under her. She is the Director- Cultural Events of MEDAI The Stage Bengaluru, one of the Black Box Theatre in Chennai, Bangalore & Coimbatore. She was under the training of Smt. Sharmila Mukherjee at Sanjali Centre for Odissi Dance for a while after moving to Bangalore. Dancing Career The first breakthrough milestone in her dancing career came in the form of an award from All India Dance Drama & Music Festival (Cuttack Mahotsav) organized by Utkala Yuva Sanskrutik Sangh, Cuttack Orissa, where she was also honored with “NRITYA SHREE”. She continued to sculpt herself into a fine dancer by taking further training under the able guidance of Guru Aloka Kanungo. The next achievement was her performance in KONARK DANCE FESTIVAL, Orissa. After this there was no looking back for her as she won many prizes in a number of prestigious competitions all over India. She has performed in various festivals like “MUKTESHWAR FESTIVAL, Bhubaneswar”, “KALA GHODA DANCE FESTIVAL, Mumbai”, “UDAY SHANKAR DANCE FESTIVAL, Kolkata, “SOORYA FESTIVAL, Kerala” and many more. Internationally , she has performed for ‘Festival of India’ in Tunisia organised by the Ministry of Culture, India and Indian Embassy, Tunisia. Also, on the occasion Republic Day Celebration in Seychelles organised by ICCR as an ensemble member of Sanjali Centre for Odissi Dance. She has been fortunate also to train through the workshops under the renowned Odissi exponents like Dr.Sonal Mansingh, Smt. Sujata Mohapatra and many more. Apart from her dancing career academically she has completed her graduation degree from Calcutta University and post-graduation from IHM, Kolkata. She has also received a certificate of excellence from the Department of Parliament Affairs.

name: Dispatch : letters to the living - Avani Films
description: Avani Films Dispatch: letters to the living Directed by Anu Vaidyanathan Get your tickets here. Following the death of her beloved mother-in-law—a mathematician and refugee from pre-Partition Punjab—filmmaker Anu Vaidyanathan embarks on a deeply personal journey across India. Bridging North and South India, Dispatch: Letters to the Living weaves together the lives of her mother and mother-in-law to examine marriage, grief, motherhood, and the invisible labor passed down through generations. Equal parts visual poem and intimate inquiry, the documentary reflects on what women are expected to leave behind as they move between families—and how their stories endure. Avani Films Founded by filmmaker and author Anu Vaidyanathan, Avani Films is an independent production house dedicated to subversive, layered, and boundary-pushing non-fiction cinema. Operating across India and internationally, the company champions intimate, women-led storytelling that explores themes of memory, grief, migration, and invisible labor. Its debut feature documentary, Dispatch: Letters to the Living, premiered on the international festival circuit alongside an expanding slate of documentaries and short films.https://www.avanifilms.com/ Anu Vaidyanathan Anu Vaidyanathan is an Indian filmmaker, author, comedian, and former endurance athlete whose work blends sharp personal inquiry with lyrical visual storytelling. A PhD in Electrical Engineering turned creative polymath, she made history as the first Indian to complete the Ultraman triathlon before publishing her acclaimed memoir, Anywhere But Home. Through her production banner, Avani Films, she writes, directs, and produces cross-cultural documentaries and narrative shorts—including her debut feature documentary, Dispatch: Letters to the Living—exploring identity, motherhood, and familial memory.

name: Meet Alankrita Amaya
description: COURTYARD KOOTA in association with FUNKY RAINBOW presents MEET ALANKRITA AMAYA (29th NOVEMBER 2026) Session Duration: 1 and a half hours (11:00am to 12:30pm) Recommended Audience: 5+ years and adults of all ages Adults and children will need separate tickets. Book in Focus: Magic Stitches (published by Tulika)   ABOUT THE SESSION Enjoy an exciting story-art-craft session with author-illustrator Alankrita Amaya as you explore her wonderful new wordless picture book, 'Magic Stitches'. Learn to use only art to craft your own wordless stories!   ABOUT ALANKRITA AMAYA Alankrita Amaya is an award-winning children’s book illustrator and writer who spends her days creating whimsical worlds filled with wonder. Her work is inspired by the magic hidden in everyday life. Some of her acclaimed books include Little Laali, Muft Ki Kulfi and Boodabim. She is also the co-founder of Hallubol, an initiative that preserves local Dakhni culture through bilingual comics. When she’s not making books, Alankrita can be found talking to cats, making candles or tending to her garden.   BOOKS BY THE AUTHOR-ILLUSTRATOR Boodabim (Rs. 175); Who is Boodabim? (Rs. 325); I’m Going to the Zoo! (Rs. 175); Little Laali (Rs. 175); Miaow! (Rs. 95); Magic Stitches (Rs. 195) (all published by Tulika) Powerful Hanuman (Rs. 275); Tomato Thief (Rs. 275); Tomato Flood (Rs. 250) (all published by Tota Books) Gutargoo (Rs. 599); Chuglubugloo (Rs. 599) (both published by T4 Tales) A Kulfi for Free! (Rs. 45) When Will Amma Be Back? (Rs. 75) (both published by Pratham) The Taxi Ride and Other Spooky Stories (Rs. 200) (published by MS Moochi Books) Can You Drew Love, Abbu? (Rs. 399) (published by Little Dipper) The Flower Demon (Rs. 160) (published by Jyotsana Prakashan) Champu's Trip to Outerspace (Rs. 399) (published by Adidev Press) Mard Bann (Rs. 300) Abba Aari! (Rs. 300) (both published by Hallubol)   NOTE FOR THE PARENTS This Event and the Pop-Up Bookshop have been curated by Funky Rainbow. The Meet-the-Author sessions conducted at Courtyard Koota in association with Funky Rainbow are a unique opportunity for you and your child to meet some of India’s most popular creators of children’s books. Funky Rainbow, Bangalore’s Beloved Independent Children’s Bookstore, will put up books of the visiting author for sale at the venue at the time of the session. Give your child the unforgettable experience of getting autographed copies of their books!   ABOUT FUNKY RAINBOW Funky Rainbow (established in 2013) is India’s only independent bookstore with an exclusive focus on Indian children's books in English and Indian languages. Our bookshop (our flagship bookstore is located in JP Nagar, Bangalore) and book consultancy was founded by a team of experienced publishing-industry professionals with the aim of introducing books to young readers in exciting ways. Our curatorial team handpicks books for children in the age group of 0-18 years, with a focus on including a diverse mix of titles and genres that are not easily available in mainstream and online bookstores. Our second bookshop was opened in Mysore in July 2025. Besides our stores, Funky Rainbow works with schools across the country, conducting literature festivals, running book clubs and reading programmes, and helping set up libraries with a curated collection of Indian and international books. We also train teachers and librarians to build literacy skills, develop a love for reading, and eventually embed Indian books into the curriculum. name: The Grandeur of Gwalior
description: The Grandeur of Gwalior A Journey through the Gharana Lens A Hindustani Vocal Concert Ruturaj Kolpe : Vocal Shantanu Deshmukh : Tabla Sreeraksha Shanbog : Harmonium Gwalior, a land where it is believed that even a child’s cry is in tune. The Grandeur of Gwalior promises a morning of enchanting ragas from the fountainhead of all khayal gharanas of Hindustani vocal music, the Gwalior Gharana. The programme offers a bouquet of compositions sung in the Gwalior style: khayal, khayalnuma, tappa, tap-tarana, bandish ki thumri, bol-banaav ki thumri and ashtapadi. Some of the most beautiful forms sung in the parampara shall be woven together with anecdotes from the past, stories of the masters of yesteryear, and rare compositions inherited by the Pandits of Gwalior. From the Khansahibs to the Pandits, from kings to commoners, from royal patronage to lokashraya, this is a journey through the many lives of the music. It is an experience of a bygone era, of what royalty once listened to. A time warp, gently unfolding in the quiet of the morning. Ruturaj Kolpe, disciple of Vidushi Dr. Meeta Pandit, presents the programme in an intimate baithak setting. In AccompanimentShantanu Deshmukh, tablaShreeraksha Shanbhog, harmonium ARTIST BRIEF(S): Ruturaj Kolpe (Vocal) Ruturaj Kolpe is an emerging, consummate Indian classical vocalist of the Gwalior Gharana, whose virtuosity, and technical prowess have been honed over years of dedicated practice and training under renowned gurus and academicians, namely Vidushi Dr. Meeta Pandit and Dr. Sandhya Kathavate. He is a recipient of the prestigious Pt. Padmakar Kulkarni Yuva Puraskar at the 25th Swarsagar Festival, Ratilal Bhavsar Puraskar from Naadbrahma Pariwar, Rohini Bhate Smruti Yuva Gayak Puraskar from Gaanwardhan, Pune and the Swaramayee Gurukul – Dr. Prabha Atre Foundation Award at the hands of Padmavibhushan Dr. Prabha Atre, including the Anubhav Gurukul Scholarship from SPICMACAY. A Sangeet Alankar with distinction from the Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya Mandal Mumbai, Ruturaj holds a Masters degree in Regulatory Affairs & Quality Assurance from the prestigious University of Technology Sydney. Shantanu Deshmukh (Tabla) Trained under celebrated gurus like Pt. Suresh Samant, Pt. Arvind Kumar Azad, Pt. Shubhankar Banerjee and now, Pt. Yogesh Samsi, Shantanu Deshmukh is a rare blend of the aesthetics of the Punjab, Farukhabad and Benaras gharanas of Tabla. He has accompanied stalwarts such as Ustad Shahid Parvez Khan, Ustad Shakir Khan, and toured for SPICMACAY, ICCR and internationally in Morocco for the Association du Festival Fes de la Culture Soufie 2022. He has completed his master’s in music from Lalit Kala Kendra, University of Pune and has recently composed background music for the short film Bliss of Letter. Shreeraksha Shanbhog (Harmonium) A disciple of Pt. Ravindra Katoti, Shreeraksha is a CCRT scholarship holder and has performed on prestigious stages like the Jackfruit Festival curated by Smt. Shubha Mudgal and also accompanied leading musicians at a young age.
